description: Condition that causes a flow to be executed.

Manual.description: Triggers the flow via an API call or UI action.

enabled.description: Allows to pause an individual trigger.

cooldown.description: Minimum interval between activations of the trigger. If the trigger fires again within the interval, the activation is postponed until the interval ends, batching multiple activations into one flow run.

cooldownMaxBatch.description: If the trigger is activated this many times during the `cooldown` interval, it fires without waiting for the interval to end.

Schedule.description: Triggers the flow on a cron schedule.

enabled.description: Allows to pause an individual trigger.

cooldown.description: Minimum interval between activations of the trigger. If the trigger fires again within the interval, the activation is postponed until the interval ends, batching multiple activations into one flow run.

cooldownMaxBatch.description: If the trigger is activated this many times during the `cooldown` interval, it fires without waiting for the interval to end.

cron.description: Cron5 expression defining the schedule e.g. `@daily` or `*/30 * * * *`.

Interval.description: Triggers the flow at regular intervals.

enabled.description: Allows to pause an individual trigger.

cooldown.description: Minimum interval between activations of the trigger. If the trigger fires again within the interval, the activation is postponed until the interval ends, batching multiple activations into one flow run.

cooldownMaxBatch.description: If the trigger is activated this many times during the `cooldown` interval, it fires without waiting for the interval to end.

Event.description: Triggers the flow when an event bus event matching one of the filters is observed.

enabled.description: Allows to pause an individual trigger.

events.description: Filters the event by type and fields.

cooldown.description: Minimum interval between activations of the trigger. If the trigger fires again within the interval, the activation is postponed until the interval ends, batching multiple activations into one flow run.

cooldownMaxBatch.description: If the trigger is activated this many times during the `cooldown` interval, it fires without waiting for the interval to end.

Source.description: Triggers the flow when a source receives new data, with optional batching controls.

enabled.description: Allows to pause an individual trigger.

cooldown.description: Minimum interval between activations of the trigger. If the trigger fires again within the interval, the activation is postponed until the interval ends, batching multiple activations into one flow run.

cooldownMaxBatch.description: If the trigger is activated this many times during the `cooldown` interval, it fires without waiting for the interval to end.

source.description: Reference to the source resource that drives this trigger.

minRecordsToAwait.description: Minimum number of new records to accumulate before triggering.

maxAwaitInterval.description: Maximum time to wait for `minRecordsToAwait` before triggering anyway e.g. `1h`.

InputsUpdated.description: Triggers the flow when inputs of a derivative dataset receive new data, with optional batching controls.

enabled.description: Allows to pause an individual trigger.

cooldown.description: Minimum interval between activations of the trigger. If the trigger fires again within the interval, the activation is postponed until the interval ends, batching multiple activations into one flow run.

cooldownMaxBatch.description: If the trigger is activated this many times during the `cooldown` interval, it fires without waiting for the interval to end.

target.description: Selector of derivative datasets whose inputs are watched. Defaults to the flow-level target when omitted.

minRecordsToAwait.description: Minimum number of new input records to accumulate before triggering.

maxAwaitInterval.description: Maximum time to wait for `minRecordsToAwait` before triggering anyway e.g. `1h`.
